Claiming is not mutation authorization. A separate durable start revalidates fresh ownership, expiry, account, route, native inventory and serving sibling proof. Existing delete journal and provider absence confirmation remain authoritative.

Human output views show loading, empty and failure states and wrap long lines on mobile; raw subscription formats and scope boundaries are preserved.
An active global gate still allows explicit eligible-scope rechecking; duplicate clicks are guarded.
Provider/proxy isolation, quotas, Desired, growth spacing and deletion admission are unchanged.
